rules: When the approved requirements basis, investigation, design spec, revision record, and supplemental artifacts are ready for architecture review.
When the design has a requirement gap, design impact, or unclear ownership that requires solution revision before implementation.
When the complete solution package passes architecture review and is ready for implementation.
When implementation discovers a requirement gap, design impact, or unclear behavior that must be resolved upstream.
When the reviewed design is implemented, implementation-scoped validation is complete, and the cumulative implementation package is ready for source review.
When source review finds an implementation-owned defect or local fix that must be corrected before executable coverage.
When implementation review passes and the cumulative package is ready for API, E2E, and executable coverage investigation.
When post-API/E2E durable test-code review passes and the complete validated package is ready for delivery.
When API/E2E coverage passes and durable test changes need proportional review, or when failure-origin review must classify the owning change.
When executable validation identifies an implementation-owned failure that requires a source correction before coverage can resume.
When docs sync, finalization, release or deployment checks, and rollout verification are complete and the coordinator needs the final delivery status.
